metadata.title: Who Leaked the Screenshot?
metadata.subtitle: Five friends. One forwarded file. Nobody has the whole story.

causeOptions.label: A private image was forwarded to an outsider by mistake
A misleading public quote was mistaken for the screenshot
Someone outside the group accessed a member account

resolutionOptions.label: Tell the affected person, secure the chat, and correct the record
Publish an accusation before the evidence is settled
Ignore the leak and take no further action

personas.publicBio: Handles sharing links and event files
Made a provocative joke earlier in the chat

variants.publicIntro: A private group screenshot appeared outside the chat at 20:42. You must establish how it happened and decide what the group should do.

chain.truth: Ada saved a screenshot for personal notes within the group.
Ada synced her screenshot from personal notes into the shared folder.
Emeka renamed a shared folder so the event flyer and screenshot had similar labels.
Tobi forwarded the screenshot attachment to outsider Kemi, believing it was the event flyer.
Zainab noticed the image outside the group and warned the members.
Feyi joked that they had planned to leak it, but did not forward the file.

missions.description: Avoid receiving a majority of personal-blame votes.
Get the group to settle the incident responsibly.
Identify the person who actually forwarded the attachment.
Avoid receiving a majority of personal-blame votes.

abilities.description: Learn which lead one chosen person investigated, not its result.
Unlock an additional link from the file-transfer timeline.
Verify the delivery log for a matching outbound file.
Retrieve a hash match from the archive.
Delay the optional public joke clue by one round if used in round one.

roleCards.startingMemory: You sent Kemi a file at about 20:41, thinking it was the event flyer.
roleCards.midgameMemory: You sent the file without opening its preview first.
roleCards.blindInvolvement: The attachment was the private screenshot; your forward caused the leak.

roleCards.startingMemory: You created a screenshot for your own notes at about 20:14.
roleCards.midgameMemory: Your notes app later synchronised with the shared folder.
roleCards.blindInvolvement: Your original image was copied into the shared file folder, but you did not send it outside.

roleCards.startingMemory: You saw the screenshot outside the group at about 20:42.
roleCards.midgameMemory: You posted a warning shortly after seeing it.
roleCards.blindInvolvement: Your warning started a rumour but did not cause the external leak.

roleCards.startingMemory: You reorganised file names while cleaning a shared folder yesterday.
roleCards.midgameMemory: You remember one screenshot and one flyer had nearly identical names.
roleCards.blindInvolvement: Your folder change made a filename mix-up more likely.

roleCards.startingMemory: You made an exaggerated joke about leaking the group chat.
roleCards.midgameMemory: Your message was sent after the screenshot had already appeared outside.
roleCards.blindInvolvement: Your remark became a false lead; you did not forward the screenshot.

evidence.title: First external appearance
evidence.body: The screenshot first appeared outside the group at 20:42.

evidence.title: Original image
evidence.body: Ada saved an image in her private notes at 20:14.

evidence.title: Warning message
evidence.body: Zainab alerted the group shortly after 20:42.

evidence.title: Folder rename log
evidence.body: Two file names were similar after a shared-folder cleanup at 20:26.

evidence.title: Outbound delivery log
evidence.body: Tobi sent a file to Kemi at 20:41. The file hash matches the screenshot.

evidence.title: Archive hash match
evidence.body: Independent archive metadata shows Tobi sent Kemi a file at 20:41 with the private screenshot hash.

evidence.title: Suspicious joke
evidence.body: Feyi joked about leaking the chat before the emergency meeting. This does not prove a leak.

evidence.title: Your file preview
evidence.body: Your 20:41 attachment preview was the private screenshot, not the event flyer.

evidence.title: Your original copy
evidence.body: Your notes image moved into the shared folder, but your device sent nothing outside.

evidence.title: Your warning effect
evidence.body: Your message spread suspicion after the external appearance.

evidence.title: Your folder effect
evidence.body: Your earlier rename left two confusingly similar attachments.

evidence.title: Your joke in context
evidence.body: Your comment was performative; no transfer originated from your account.

twist.headline: An old message makes Feyi look suspicious.

variants.revealSummary: Tobi forwarded the wrong file to Kemi at 20:41. The file-name collision contributed to the mistake; later jokes and warnings confused the group.
